rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for enjoyment or something enjoyable.

example.english: The greatest pleasure of travelling is meeting new friends.
example.traditional: 旅行最大樂趣係識到新朋友。
example.jyutping: leoi5 hang4 zeoi3 daai6 lok6 ceoi3 hai6 sik1 dou2 san1 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this for the general state or feeling of happiness and contentment.

example.english: Eating with my family gives me a lot of pleasure.
example.traditional: 同屋企人一齊食飯，我覺得好快樂。
example.jyutping: tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 faai3 lok6

rows.note: Use this specifically for physical or sexual enjoyment.

example.english: I only get sexual pleasure when I’m with you.
example.jyutping: tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 sin1 jau5 sing3 faai3 gam2

rows.note: Use this formal word for the social sense of being honored, as in being pleased to meet someone.

example.english: It is a great pleasure and honor to represent the company at this event.
example.traditional: 能夠代表公司出席呢個場合，我感到非常榮幸。
example.jyutping: nang4 gau3 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 ceot1 zik6 ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 wing4 hang6
